source_verification_receipts.version: Electronic Communications in Probability 16 (2011), published PDF
source_verification_receipts.verified_claim: Matrix Freedman controls adapted matrix martingales through bounded differences and predictable quadratic variation.
The paper develops adaptively reweighted augmented-IPW inference for adaptively collected experiments.
The paper studies model-free weighting for general nonuniform matrix missingness and supplies matrix-recovery guarantees and a heterogeneous-setting minimax lower bound.
The paper develops debiased low-rank-projection inference for linear forms under i.i.d. noisy matrix-completion observations.
The paper establishes high-dimensional martingale Gaussian couplings and multiplier-bootstrap approximation for maxima.

source_verification_receipts.version: Annals of Statistics 53(5) (2025), official issue PDF
source_verification_receipts.verified_claim: The paper studies fully online inference with adaptively collected low-rank matrix contexts, rather than batch IPW-SVD rowwise recovery.

source_verification_receipts.version: Annals of Statistics 53(6) (2025), official issue PDF
source_verification_receipts.verified_claim: The paper studies adaptive sequential experiments and unit-by-time counterfactual means using nonlinear-factor and nearest-neighbor methods.

Turn total drift into an observable diagnostic or a computable upper certificate, so the blind frontier supports the stated data-steward decision rather than only an oracle characterization.
